scenarios.scenario: A caller attempts cookie-only, missing, malformed Basic, x-api-key, or query-string identity instead of Bearer authorization.
scenarios.rationale: The mocked route adapter test confirms these requests return 401 before identity lookup, MCP transport, or downstream handler dispatch.

scenarios.scenario: A caller supplies mismatched API-key and Clerk-session identities.
scenarios.rationale: The mocked adapter test proves a copyIdentity conflict fails before transport dispatch, but actual Clerk ambient-session behavior through the Next route awaits the unrun local-fixture E2E.

scenarios.scenario: Caller-controlled Host, Origin, Cookie, Forwarded, or X-Forwarded-Host attempts to alter a downstream destination or leak headers.
scenarios.rationale: The adapter test observes fixed first-party URLs and only Authorization plus Content-Type on synthetic downstream requests; the route source has no caller-derived destination.

scenarios.scenario: A denied source request exposes protected source text or is retried as a transient network failure.
scenarios.rationale: The package and mocked route gates assert protected-source sentinels are absent, structured denial reasons are preserved, and denial responses are not retried.

scenarios.scenario: A malformed or unsafe source identifier reaches a first-party handler, or a transient retry changes its request UUID.
scenarios.rationale: The AC4 package gate passes exact-key, safe-integer, and UUID validation; the default fetch-boundary failure retries once with the identical request body and UUID.

scenarios.scenario: A TypeError from an injected in-process route handler is mistaken for a network failure and repeats source admission.
scenarios.rationale: The focused regression test injects an ordinary TypeError, expects it to propagate, and asserts the dispatcher is called exactly once. Only fetch-boundary TypeErrors are wrapped as HigherBitsNetworkError.

scenarios.scenario: The actual Next runtime mishandles SSE initialization, Clerk/cookie identity, or stream cancellation.
scenarios.rationale: The actual-route Playwright test was not run because safe local test fixtures and server prerequisites were unavailable.

scenarios.scenario: Repeated or concurrent requests violate authoritative quota, grant, or idempotency behavior.
scenarios.rationale: The exact tracked migration passed isolated local RLS/grant, sequential replay/idempotency, quota/reset, pro-exemption, grant-rate, and ten-session concurrent-admission assertions. This rules out the scenario for the tested local migration only; deployed behavior and full MCP-to-database routing remain unverified.
